feature.label: OVF Server Explorer
feature.description:
Server Explorer view for KNIME 5.x -- browse remote HTTP or local filesystem workflow shares alongside KNIME Explorer.
Who gets it depends on the KNIME folder, not on a choice in this wizard: if you cannot write to the folder, it installs for your account only and other people using this KNIME will not see it. To install for all users, or to check the folder's permissions first, use install-ovf from the installer zip instead of this wizard.
The tab appears next to KNIME Explorer after restart. If it does not: View > Other... > KNIME Views > Server Explorer.
